examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Type of the SegmentButton component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to create two different types of SegmentButton components by configuring SegmentButtonOptions with tab and capsule types.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Style of the SegmentButton component
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use CommonSegmentButtonOptions to customize the text and background style of the SegmentButton component.

examples.title: Example 3: Performing Array Operations on the SegmentButton Component
examples.description: This example shows how to perform operations such as adding and removing segmented buttons using array functions like pop, shift, and unshift.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing a Mirrored Layout
examples.description: This example shows how to implement a mirrored layout for a SegmentButton component by configuring direction.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting Accessibility
examples.description: This example showcases how to implement accessibility features for the SegmentButton component by configuring attributes such as accessibilityLevel and selectedIconAccessibilityText.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting Custom Border Radius
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set a custom border radius for the SegmentButton component.

examples.title: Example 7: Enabling Property Animation for SegmentButton
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to enable property animation for the SegmentButton component. When enableStateAnimation is set to true, modifying the selectedIndexes value triggers a smooth transition animation for the selected item. Two SegmentButton components with the same selected index will display different transition animations based on whether property animation is enabled.
The enableStateAnimation property is added to SegmentButton since API version 24.
